canonical_terminal_input_fence.commit_durability: complete canonical event line fdatasync acknowledged before reduction begins

conditionally_allowed_integrity_event.condition: only to record a post-freeze closeout/idempotency integrity fault
conditionally_allowed_integrity_event.effect: blocks clean closeout or requires recovery; never changes the fenced semantic prefix or sealed semantic result

freeze_event_sha256_binding.rule: freeze_event_sha256 is the enclosing canonical event.event_sha256; it is not duplicated inside the hashed payload, avoiding a self-hash cycle
freeze_event_sha256_binding.validation: event hash, sequence, predecessor, contract, epoch, proposer/committer and payload hash all verify

payload_required.allowed_post_freeze_event_types: exact closed ordered allowlist bound by payload hash

canonical_terminal_input_fence.post_fence_rule: reject every proposal that could add or replace semantic input; retries of already committed event_id values are handled only by journal-derived idempotency
canonical_terminal_input_fence.semantic_prefix: starts at sequence 1 and ends inclusively at TERMINAL_REDUCTION_PREPARED

closeout_head.meaning: final canonical event; no canonical append is legal after it

semantic_reduction_head.meaning: inclusive immutable semantic input prefix consumed by reducer

terminal_decision_head.meaning: canonical event binding reduction hash, reducer, antecedent semantic_reduction_head and semantic_result

monotonicity: later closeout events cannot rewrite semantic_result
conflicting terminal proposal is an integrity fault, not precedence resolution

recovery.crash_after_closeout_head: materialize/read back completion receipt from immutable journal and seal; append nothing
recovery.crash_after_decision: recover decision by journal replay and continue closeout; never compute or commit a second terminal decision
recovery.crash_after_fence_before_decision: verify journal and exact fence, then rerun exact reducer over same inclusive prefix; no new semantic evidence accepted
